cearExperience.summary: I developed the software engineering and technological modernization at CEAR Latinoamericano. I designed and deployed an end-to-end ecosystem of 4 scalable web platforms that thoroughly transformed the institution's academic, sales, marketing, and lead acquisition operations.
cearExperience.pillarsSubtitle: Fundamental engineering principles that guided my day-to-day work:

pillars.title: High-Availability Architecture & Backend
pillars.description: Design of modular, scalable APIs using NestJS and Express, relational data modeling in PostgreSQL optimized with Drizzle ORM, and asynchronous background job queues powered by BullMQ and Redis.

pillars.title: Modern Frontend & User Experience
pillars.description: Development of responsive interfaces using Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Implementation of dynamic TanStack Table modules for heavy data catalogs and hybrid SSR/ISR rendering.

pillars.title: DevOps, On-Premise VPS & Data Sovereignty
pillars.description: Comprehensive containerization with Docker and Docker Compose, provisioning of CEAR's On-Premise VPS, network hardening, SSL/TLS certificates, and automated scheduled backups.

pillars.title: Digital Transformation of Business Workflows
pillars.description: Replacement of manual WhatsApp and spreadsheet processes with a unified pipeline connecting public web enrollment, CRM with task supervision, and automated bulk email prospecting.

cearExperience.systemsTitle: The Ecosystem of 4 Platforms I Built
cearExperience.systemsSubtitle: Each solution eliminated a critical operational bottleneck. Explore each technical case study:

systems.title: CEAR Virtual Campus
systems.description: Official online learning and exam platform with Niubiz payment integration, synchronized live lectures, 200+ concurrent student support, and RBAC administration.

systems.title: Mailer System & Automation
systems.description: Internal 1,000 emails/minute dispatch engine with BullMQ, SendGrid API, Unlayer drag-and-drop template builder, and real-time open and bounce tracking.

systems.title: Internal CRM & RNP Lead Management
systems.description: Internal platform to centralize and qualify +200,000 RNP procurement entities, featuring Marketing Manager task distribution to sales reps and Mailer feedback integration.

systems.title: Continuing Education Web Platform
systems.description: Public Next.js (SSR/ISR) website showcasing specialized JRD, Arbitration, NEC, and FIDIC programs, with integrated enrollment forms replacing WhatsApp outreach.
